desc: Ideation: cycle contraction + tree DP with prefix sums, O(N·M)
Parse input; build graph from A; find all cycles via in-degree elimination (topological peeling) to identify cycle nodes.
Contract each cycle into one component root; build the rooted forest structure (children lists).
Implement DP: f_u(v) = product over children of prefix sums; reverse topological order.
Verify correctness on samples 1 and 2 by manual trace; found and diagnosed bug: multi-node cycles must share one value, contributions are per-cycle products of f_r(v), not independent roots.

Produce final corrected code: group cycle nodes by cycle, component contribution = Σ_v ∏_{r∈cycle} f_r(v); verified all three samples (6, 2025, 10010) by manual trace; edge cases (self-loops, N=1, M=1, full cycle) checked; memory considerations addressed.
